symptom: scheduled_events() returns events of modules listed in excludeModules (Marketplace modules MicrosoftGraph, OIDC), and each event has an empty module_name; qualified_name becomes .Name.
cause: LintContext.ScheduledEvents() is reader-backed, not catalog-backed, and mapped the event's direct ContainerID to a module name. An event inside a folder (how every Marketplace module ships them) has a folder as container, so the lookup missed, module_name was "", and IsExcluded("") is false, so the exclusion silently did nothing.
insight: Any iterator that resolves a module from ContainerID must walk the folder chain (the catalog's hierarchy.findModuleID does); grep for ContainerID lookups against a module map. The existing tests could not see it for a second reason: their helper closed the catalog before returning it, so the module query failed silently in every test and module_name was never asserted. An empty module_name is the tell for both, and IsExcluded("") turns it into an exclusion leak.
